summary: Backend-only regression run of the P0/P1 audit batch (SEC-01/02/04, B01, B06, B09, B13/B15, B16, B19, B22, B04/B05) and sanity checks on older flows. New file: test_iter125_audit_money_security.py, 29 tests: 25 pass, 4 fail. Also re-ran test_iter124_refunds.py and test_iter123_return_restock.py: 9/9 pass. All money/stock tests used throwaway registered users and TEST_ products. Fixes that work: auth injection 422, session revocation after a profile password change or a reset, purchase_price hidden on all 6 public endpoints and still shown to admin, cart qty<=0 gives 422, stock is not credited twice on cancel->rollback->cancel->delete, B09 stock reconcile up/down/removal, approve twice gives 400, reward not paid twice on a second fulfil, pay-additional twice charges once, deferral debt released on client and admin cancel, merge works and blocks cancelled and in-flight card orders. Failures: (1) B22: cancelling after a partial shipment wipes the debt for the shipped goods. (2) B15/B13: return quantity 0 is accepted and turned into 1. (3) Older bug: an admin item edit drops delivery_fee from the order total. (4) Rolling back a cancelled order does not reserve stock again, so shipping it later creates phantom stock.

critical.endpoint: POST /api/orders/{id}/cancel and PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status (deferral order after partial fulfil)
critical.issue: B22 not met. Deferral order: 2 units at 1000 plus 500 delivery. After shipping 1 unit, debt correctly becomes 1500. After cancelling the rest, debt goes to 0, so the client keeps the shipped goods without owing anything. Cause: routes/credit.py sync_deferral_debt sets target = 0.0 whenever status == 'cancelled', even when items have quantity_fulfilled > 0. It should use deferral_debt_target(order, items) on cancel (shipped value plus delivery) and close the entry only if nothing was shipped. All 3 cancel call sites pass {**order, 'status': 'cancelled'}, so they all hit this.

Stock: the rollback does not reserve stock again, and stock_restored_at stays set. A later PATCH /fulfill of that order shipped 2 units while product stock stayed 20 (was 20), so phantom stock appears. The same goes for money and debt: the refund given on cancel is not taken back, and the cancelled deferral stays cancelled. Options: block rollback from cancelled, or on rollback take the stock again (error if short), unset stock_restored_at, charge back the refund and re-open the deferral.

minor.issue: A return item with quantity 0 is accepted (200): returns.py line 84 `int(item.get('quantity', 1) or 1)` turns 0 into 1. Negative quantities are rejected. Fix: qty = int(item.get('quantity', 0)); reject if <= 0.

Older bug: total is recalculated as sum(price*qty) only. delivery_fee (500) and any discount, cashback or promo are dropped. Example: order total 1400 = 900 goods + 500 delivery; after a +100 price edit the total is 1000 instead of 1500. With accept-changes, a +500 price edit gave price_difference 0, so no surcharge was requested. Later refund and deferral math built on order.total is affected too.

The new token uses the stale user.auth_version + 1 instead of the value just saved. If two password changes run at once, the current session can log itself out. Low risk: read auth_version back with find_one_and_update(return_document=AFTER).

action_items: Fix sync_deferral_debt on cancel: keep the shipped value plus delivery as debt when quantity_fulfilled > 0, instead of always 0
Fix rollback-status from cancelled: reserve stock again (or block the rollback), unset stock_restored_at, charge back the refund and re-open the deferral
Reject return item quantity 0 (remove the `or 1` coercion in returns.py)
Admin order item edit: keep delivery_fee (and discounts) when recalculating total
critical_code_review_comments: credit.py sync_deferral_debt: on cancel the target is 0 no matter what was shipped (see B22 above)
warehouse.restore_order_stock idempotency works, but stock_restored_at is never cleared, so the rollback path above leaves an order active with no reservation
admin.update_admin_order cancel branch calls refund_order_cashback twice (inside restore_order_stock and again directly). It is safe only if refund_order_cashback is idempotent; please verify
merge_orders transaction looks correct. notify_user runs outside the transaction, which is fine
rewards.accrue_order_reward CAS compares a float reward_accrued_base for equality. This works because values are rounded to 2 decimals, but an integer-cents field would be safer
pay_additional_amount: card/crypto branch still returns redirect info without a claim, which is fine because nothing is charged there

success_rate.backend: 86% (25/29 new tests; 9/9 older refund and return-restock regression)

test_credentials: Used admin (ADMIN_PASSWORD env), 0x0errorr@gmail.com/admin123, user@demo.com/demo123, test.manager@avarus.ru (login, overview and clients only). Money and stock tests used freshly registered test_*@example.com users.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Per run: 1 client user + 2 'TEST_Audit' products (stock 20, purchase_price 600), plus extra users for the password tests, all deleted by id in teardown. Orders were deleted by id through DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id}. 11 orders and 6 merged_orders_archive docs left behind by an aborted first run were removed, filtered by full_name 'TEST Аудит' and a missing (deleted test) user_id. The conftest session fixture stock_for_orders (pre-existing) adds and later writes off temporary stock on low-stock products. No unfiltered deletes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iter125_audit_money_security.py -p no:xdist -v (about 5-6 min through the public ingress, so run it in the background; the 300s foreground limit kills it). Expected failing until fixed: TestReturns::test_return_capped_by_shipped_and_single_approve (qty 0), TestDeferral::test_partial_ship_then_cancel_keeps_shipped_debt, TestAdminEditTotal::test_edit_keeps_delivery_fee, TestRollbackThenShip::test_rollback_then_fulfil_takes_stock. Notes: DELETE /api/cart/clear is actually matched by DELETE /cart/{product_id}; use DELETE /api/cart to clear. The default delivery_fee is 500 for these test orders. The reset-password test writes its own password_resets doc (sha256 of a known token) for the throwaway user.
rca of the issue: B22 partial-then-cancel: sync_deferral_debt short-circuits to target=0 for status 'cancelled' and ignores quantity_fulfilled. Repro: set a credit limit, place a deferral order for 2 units, fulfil 1 (debt 1500), cancel (debt 0). Rollback phantom stock: restore_order_stock credits the goods and sets the stock_restored_at flag; rollback only flips the status back, while stock_allocations still look held, so settle_fulfilment_stock ships from a reservation that no longer exists.
